scope: Retire live NGE Build-a-Buff, general/TCG XP-buff progression, random fs_meditate_* bonuses, GCW point consumables, autonomous GCW consumable turrets, post-Publish-14 absolute player control-immunity buffs, and later reactive avoid-incapacitation heals without removing later-content data compatibility or the restored Publish 14.1 entertainer, Teras Kasi, and Jedi avoid-incapacitation lifecycles.

findings: Publish 14.1 entertainer attribute buffs are accumulated through dance/music watch and listen sessions and apply Mind, Focus, and Willpower pools.
Pinned Publish 14.1 Core3 contains no native Buff Builder, buildabuff_inspiration handler, general percentage-of-level XP buff, or TCG XP grant path.
Publish 14.1 awards explicit profession XP types from combat, crafting, and performance activity rather than scaling them from an NGE 1-90 player level.
Later buff rows and effect mappings remain compatibility data so retained expansion assets can load while their post-NGE progression handlers fail closed.

Pinned Publish 14.1 Teras Kasi meditation reduces DOT strength and heals wounds; the inherited every-third-tick Force Sensitive branch that randomly granted fs_meditate_* expertise, resource-quality, or modified-primary-stat bonuses is retired.

The retained GCW banner's nine Roadmap class buffs apply NGE modified primaries, Luck, expertise modifiers, or a proc attack absent from pinned Publish 14.1 and therefore remain data-only compatibility rows.
The retained TCG HH-15 and rocket-launcher consumables grant post-NGE percentage GCW-point bonuses rather than a Publish 14.1 faction-point rule and now remain non-consuming compatibility items.

The retained mini-turret consumable handlers create autonomous 250-500 damage, 5000-health faction turrets from later GCW content; their item and buff rows remain loadable while player admission and turret creation fail closed.

Pinned Publish 14.1 resolves combat states through accuracy versus defender state-defense skill modifiers, including the separate Jedi resistance_states roll; it does not grant timed absolute player buffs that block whole snare, root, mez, daze, armor-break, slow, or action-drain groups.

The retained Mustafar movement/mez devices, treasure snare-immunity consumable, GCW critical-heal recourse, generic player immunity rows, and daze/mez/action-drain recourses remain loadable compatibility content while their player admission and stale state fail closed; boss and beast control behavior remains available.

Pinned Publish 14.1 has an authentic Jedi avoidIncapacitation command using the avoid_incapacitation skill modifier and a distinct avoid_incap buff effect; it has no generic avoid_incap_heal consumable callback that heals a player before the incapacitated posture is applied.

The five GCW reactive stim buffs, two last-man PvP buffs, and Tusken endurance heroic buff are the complete eight-row avoid_incap_heal inventory; their retained content rows remain loadable while player admission, stale state, and the pre-incap reactive-heal callback fail closed.

A whole production-script inventory has exactly one caller of grantUnmodifiedXPPercentageOfLevel: xpGrantedGeneralAddBuffHandler, which returns at the central retirement gate before the call; the retained API itself also returns zero without consulting player level, class template, or the NGE level table.

All ordinary and crafting inspiration-XP consumers resolve to identity or zero before retained percentage data can affect Publish 14.1 explicit XP pools, closing the deferred level-percentage buff-XP authority surface.
